text.p: Petroleum Geo-Services said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 4.6 million American Depositary Shares, representing the same number of ordinary shares of the company.
It said the ADRs will be included in the Nasdaq National Market, and the Ordinary shares are listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
Proceeds will be used to expand its library of 3D multi-client seismic data, to repay outstanding debt under various credit facilities and general corporate purposes.
The company said the offering will be made outside Norway, and is to be led by Prudential Securities, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, Salomon Brothers, Simmons & Co and Cambridge Partners LLC.
